name: 6-methyl-MDA
summary: 6-Methyl-MDA, also known as 6-methyl-3,4-methylenedioxyamphetamine is an entactogen and psychedelic drug of the amphetamine and MDxx families. It was first synthesized in the late 1990s by a team including David E. Nichols at Purdue University while investigating derivatives of 3,4-methylenedioxyamphetamine (MDA) and 3,4-methylenedioxy-N-methylamphetamine (MDMA).

pharmacology.text: 6-Methyl-MDA has IC50 values of 783 nM, 28,300 nM, and 4,602 nM for inhibiting the reuptake of serotonin, dopamine, and norepinephrine in rat synaptosomes.

uses.en: It is a research compound made to study the structure of entactogens. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，用於研究同理心增強劑的結構，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，用于研究同理心增强剂的结构，没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs that release serotonin strongly, such as MDMA, can cause jaw clenching, sweating, overheating, nausea, a racing heart and a low mood in the days after. Serious risks include dangerous overheating, low blood sodium from drinking too much water, and serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。強烈釋放血清素的藥物（例如MDMA）可能引起咬緊牙關、出汗、體溫過高、噁心、心跳急促，以及之後幾天的情緒低落。嚴重風險包括危險的體溫過高、因喝太多水造成的低血鈉，以及血清素症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。强烈释放血清素的药物（例如MDMA）可能引起咬紧牙关、出汗、体温过高、恶心、心跳急促，以及之后几天的情绪低落。严重风险包括危险的体温过高、因喝太多水造成的低血钠，以及血清素症候群。

fact.en: David Nichols's team at Purdue made it in the late 1990s while mapping how ring substitutions change MDA, and the methyl group at this position leaves a much weaker drug.
fact.zh: David Nichols在普渡大學的團隊於1990年代後期合成了它，當時他們正在研究環上取代如何改變MDA；加在這個位置的甲基，使藥效弱得多。
fact.zhHans: David Nichols在普渡大学的团队于1990年代后期合成了它，当时他们正在研究环上取代如何改变MDA；加在这个位置的甲基，使药效弱得多。
